about.text: The Mexican goat's-milk version of dulce de leche, a thick, runny caramel. Goat's milk is simmered for several hours in a copper pan with sugar, bicarbonate of soda and a starch. It is stirred constantly until it thickens and turns light brown. It may be flavoured with vanilla, cinnamon or rum.

how.text: Cajeta is dulce de leche made with goat's milk, as used in Mexico and parts of Central America. The source describes no other difference in process.
